name: HYDRA-UMC-BRIDGE-AMR
notes: Real, dependency-free coordination boundary for AGV/AMR fleets: a real, hand-checkable 2D rigid-body transform (FrameTransform, now carrying a required real map_id per site/AMR) from the factory's shared coordinate frame into a specific AMR's local frame, a minimal VDA-5050-inspired order-action vocabulary (MOVE_TO_*/PICK_LOAD/DROP_LOAD/CANCEL_ORDER) gated through HYDRA-UMC-SDK's shared safety contract, and a real VDA 5050 MQTT publisher (Vda5050Publisher) that only ever publishes an already-gated dispatch to the correct real order/instantActions topic, checks the real MQTT client rc before ever reporting a dispatch as delivered, and reports success honestly as "queued for delivery", not AGV acceptance. Never plans a path or avoids an obstacle itself - that authority stays with the AMR's own onboard navigation or its fleet manager. Not yet exercised against a real fleet manager or physical AMR. v0.0.6: the test suite's own unknown-phase reproduction (a raw string BridgeJob construction) was updated to match HYDRA-UMC-SDK's own real construction-time rejection (REV-008) - split into a real construction-rejection test plus a minimal double proving the coordinator's own defensive fallback still fails closed.
